segments.title: MICROSOFT JOINS THE AI CODING BATTLE
segments.caption: Two new coding models.
segments.speech: Microsoft just raised the stakes in the AI coding battle. Should OpenAI and Anthropic be worried?

segments.title: MAI CODE 2 + CODE 2 FLASH
segments.caption: Announced November seventeenth.
segments.speech: At Ignite, Microsoft unveiled two new coding models: M A I Code Two and Code Two Flash.

segments.title: CODE 2
segments.caption: Complex fixes across your codebase.
segments.speech: Code Two is built for the tough stuff. Finding bugs, refactoring applications, and making changes across multiple files.

segments.title: CODE 2 FLASH
segments.caption: Fast, cost-efficient everyday tasks.
segments.speech: Flash is the lightweight option for quick fixes, code explanations and everyday edits. Think speed and efficiency.

segments.title: GITHUB COPILOT
segments.caption: Access varies by Copilot plan.
segments.speech: Both are available in GitHub Copilot for eligible users. Even the free tier can access Code Two Flash, subject to usage limits.

segments.title: THE RIGHT MODEL FOR THE JOB
segments.caption: More options, not a proven winner.
segments.speech: The real question is whether developers can get the quality they need at a lower cost. More competition means more choices.
